'''Anup Chandra Pandey''' (born 15 February 1959) is a retired 1984-batch [[Indian Administrative Service]] (IAS) officer belonging to the [[Uttar Pradesh]] cadre. He served as [[Election Commissioner of India]].<ref name=":4">{{Cite web|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/breaking-news-live-updates-08-06-2021/liveblog/83327452.cms|title = Breaking news live: Anup Chandra Pandey appointed election commissioner| website=[[The Times of India]] }}</ref> Pandey had also served as the [[Chief secretary (India)|Chief Secretary]] of the [[Government of Uttar Pradesh]], in addition to serving as the Infrastructure and Industrial Development Commissioner of Uttar Pradesh, before retiring on 31 August 2019. He was Member, National Green Tribunal Oversight Committee, U.P before joining Election Commission.

== Education ==
Pandey holds a [[Bachelor of Engineering]] degree in [[mechanical engineering]] from [[Punjab Engineering College]],<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://supremo.nic.in/ERSheetHtml.aspx?OffIDErhtml=14544&PageId=|title=Rajive Kumar - Executive Record Sheet|last=|first=|date=|website=Department of Personnel and Training, [[Government of India]]|access-date=14 January 2018}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=http://niyuktionline.upsdc.gov.in/ias-posting-detail.htm?21|title=IAS Posting Detail —> Dr. Anup Chandra Pandey|website=[[Department of Appointment and Personnel]], [[Government of Uttar Pradesh]]|access-date=31 October 2018}}</ref> is a [[Master of Business Administration]] in [[materials management|Business Management]],<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" /> and has a [[Doctor of Philosophy]] degree in [[ancient history|Ancient History]].<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" />

== Career ==
Pandey has served in various key positions for both the [[Government of Uttar Pradesh]] and the [[Government of India]], including as the [[Chief secretary (India)|Chief Secretary]] of Uttar Pradesh, [[Additional chief secretary|Additional Chief Secretary]] ([[Department of Infrastructure and Industrial Development|Infrastructure and Industrial Development]] and NRI), chairperson of [[Udyog Bandhu]] and Infrastructure and Industrial Development Commissioner of Uttar Pradesh, [[Divisional commissioner (India)|divisional commissioner]] of [[Lucknow division]], [[Additional Chief Secretary]] ([[Department of Finance (Uttar Pradesh)|Finance]] and Institutional Finance) and Finance Commissioner, chairperson of Pradeshiya Infrastructure and Investment Corporation of Uttar Pradesh, chairperson of [[Greater Noida|Greater NOIDA]], [[Principal secretary (India)|Principal Secretary]] (Medical Education), [[Principal secretary (India)|Principal Secretary]] (Planning) and director general of Uttar Pradesh State Planning Institute and as the [[District collector (India)|district magistrate and collector]] of two [[List of districts of Uttar Pradesh|districts]] of a unified Uttar Pradesh in the [[Government of Uttar Pradesh|Uttar Pradesh government]];<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" /> and as an [[Additional secretary to the Government of India|additional secretary]] in the [[Department of Ex-servicemen Welfare]] of the [[Ministry of Defence (India)|Ministry of Defence]], additional director general in the [[Bureau of Indian Standards]] and as a [[Joint secretary to the Government of India|joint secretary]] in the [[Ministry of Labour and Employment (India)|Ministry of Labour and Employment]] in the [[Government of India|Indian government]].<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" />

=== Infrastructure and Industrial Development Commissioner of Uttar Pradesh ===
Pandey was appointed the [[Additional chief secretary|Additional Chief Secretary]] ([[Department of Infrastructure and Industrial Development|Infrastructure and Industrial Development]] and NRI) and Infrastructure and Industrial Development Commissioner of Uttar Pradesh (IIDC), overseeing the [[Department of Infrastructure and Industrial Development]] and the Department of NRI, in September 2017;<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/agra/major-bureaucratic-rejig-in-up-days-after-yogi-met-rss-chief-36-ias-officers-shifted/articleshow/60428194.cms|title=Major bureaucratic rejig in UP days after Yogi met RSS chief; 36 IAS officers shifted|last=Jaiswal|first=Anuja|date=8 September 2017|work=[[The Times of India]]|access-date=31 October 2018|publisher=[[Bennett, Coleman & Co. Ltd.]]|location=[[Lucknow]]|oclc=23379369}}</ref> Pandey assumed the office of IIDC on 9 September 2017,<ref name=":1" /> and retired on 31 August 2019.<ref name=":3" />

=== Election Commissioner of India ===
Pandey was appointed as [[Election Commissioner of India]] on 8 June 2021.<ref name=":4" /> Pandey assumed the office on 9 June 2021 and served their till 14 February 2024.<ref>{{Cite news|date=2021-06-09|title=Anup Chandra Pandey takes charge as Election Commissioner|language=en-IN|work=The Hindu|url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/anup-chandra-pandey-takes-charge-as-election-commissioner/article34770324.ece|access-date=2021-06-10|issn=0971-751X}}</ref>
